name: markdown
description: Open Markdown Protocol (OMP): structured markdown as an intermediate representation between AI models, with validate/compile/inspect/lint/run server endpoints and an append-only feedback store that mirrors to an optional Postgres target.

serviceSurfaces.name: markdown-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: markdown-serve implements an HTTP API (GET /health and POST /validate, /compile, /inspect, /lint, /run) but does not implement the required service topology (GET /ready, GET /version) or an OpenAPI document. Server topology alignment is tracked in the contracts-alignment-r2 missing-manifest lane.

serviceSurfaces.name: markdown-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The package root export (dist/index.js) is a real library surface, but there is no OpenAPI-generated typed SDK; a supported sdk surface requires generatedFrom, which cannot be truthfully declared without an OpenAPI document. SDK generation is tracked in the contracts-alignment-r2 missing-manifest lane.
